name: PNG
description: Portable Network Graphics image file format
author: HexMarksTheSpot

fields.name: signature
fields.description: PNG signature. The first 8 bytes always contain: 89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A. This identifies the file as PNG and detects common file transfer problems.

fields.name: ihdr_length
fields.description: Length of the IHDR chunk data (always 13 for IHDR)

fields.name: ihdr_type
fields.description: Chunk type - should be 'IHDR' for the first chunk

fields.name: bit_depth
fields.description: Bit depth - number of bits per sample or per palette index. Valid values: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16

fields.name: color_type
fields.description: Color type describes how to interpret image data

fields.name: compression_method
fields.description: Compression method. Only method 0 (deflate/inflate) is defined in the standard

fields.name: filter_method
fields.description: Filter method. Only method 0 (adaptive filtering) is defined

value_map.0: Adaptive filtering with 5 basic filter types

fields.name: ihdr_crc
fields.description: CRC32 checksum of chunk type and chunk data

fields.name: remaining_chunks
fields.description: Remaining PNG chunks (IDAT, IEND, metadata chunks, etc.)
